rust_types.purpose: Public handler implementing ExtensionHandler. Holds Arc<PairingStore>. Constructors: new(), with_store(store), store(). Send+Sync via Arc.
rust_types.name: PairingHandler

rust_types.purpose: In-memory store keyed by pairing_id. Mutex<HashMap<String, PairingRecord>>. Methods: new, count, insert, get, remove, list_pending, list_all, try_redeem, cancel. All locks use .expect(pairing store mutex poisoned).
rust_types.name: PairingStore

rust_types.purpose: Internal storage record. Fields: pairing_id, secret_hash, created_at, expires_at, attempts, redeemed, allowed_transports. Not serialized to clients.
rust_types.name: PairingRecord

rust_types.purpose: Response for create. Fields: secret, pairing_id, expires_at, transports.
rust_types.name: PairingPayload

rust_types.purpose: Transport in create/redeem. Fields: type, url (skip if None), relay_id (skip if None).
rust_types.name: PairingTransport

rust_types.purpose: Transport type. Variants: Direct, Relay. Serializes as lowercase.
rust_types.name: PairingTransportType

rust_types.purpose: Item in pending_list response. Fields: pairing_id, created_at, expires_at, attempts. No secret.
rust_types.name: PendingPairing

rust_types.purpose: Client info in redeem. Fields: name, version, platform (all required, non-empty).

rust_types.purpose: Params for cancel. Fields: pairing_id.

rust_types.purpose: Response for redeem. Fields: pairing_id, redeemed, client_token, transport.
rust_types.name: PairingRedeemResponse

rust_types.purpose: Response for cancel. Fields: pairing_id, cancelled.
rust_types.name: PairingCancelResponse

rust_types.purpose: Response for transports. Fields: transports.

method_signatures.params: PairingCreateParams { ttl_seconds Option u64 default 300, allowed_transports Option Vec String default [direct,relay] } parsed via serde_json. Raw value must be JSON object or -32602. ttl_seconds in [1,86400] or -32602. allowed_transports entries must be direct or relay or -32602.
method_signatures.result: PairingPayload { secret, pairingId, expiresAt, transports }. secret format pair-secret-{uuid1.simple()}-{uuid2.simple()}. pairingId format pair-{uuid}. expiresAt RFC3339. transports at most one direct (url None) and at most one relay (relayId=ctx.connection_id when connection_id starts with relay-). Otherwise relay transport is OMITTED even if relay in allowed_transports. Secret SHA-256 hash stored, plaintext only in this response.
method_signatures.name: create

method_signatures.params: PairingRedeemParams { secret String non-empty-after-trim, client_info ClientInfo { name version platform all non-empty-after-trim } } parsed via serde_json. Raw value must be JSON object or -32602. spec no scope required, v1 allows empty principal.
method_signatures.result: PairingRedeemResponse { pairingId, redeemed true, clientToken format ct-{uuid} returned once, transport }. Transport derived from ctx.connection_id: relay with relayId=ctx.connection_id if starts with relay-, else direct with url None. Plaintext secret never stored nor in response.
method_signatures.name: redeem
errors: -32002 forbidden whitespace secret, no match, already redeemed, expired

method_signatures.params: PaginationParams { cursor Option String, limit Option usize } parsed via serde_json. Raw value must be JSON object or -32602. limit=0 returns -32602. invalid hex cursor returns -32602.
method_signatures.result: PaginatedResult PendingPairing { items, nextCursor, hasMore }. Items no secret. Sorted by created_at ASC. Filtered: redeemed and expired excluded. Default limit 20, max 100.
method_signatures.name: pending_list

method_signatures.params: PairingCancelParams { pairing_id String non-empty-after-trim } parsed via serde_json. Raw value must be JSON object or -32602.
method_signatures.result: PairingCancelResponse { pairingId, cancelled true }. Pending pairing atomically removed. Already-redeemed or expired returns not_found.
method_signatures.name: cancel

method_signatures.params: Empty object {}. Read-only, ignores params. Raw value must be JSON object or -32602.
method_signatures.result: PairingTransportsResponse { transports: [ { type direct, available true, label Local Network }, { type relay, available bool, relayId Option String, label Cloud Relay } ] }. Direct always available. Relay available only when connection_id starts with relay-. Both always returned (unlike create which omits relay when not on relay connection).
method_signatures.name: transports

concerns: Spec/Task discrepancy: task lists create,get,list,revoke,redeem but spec defines create,redeem,pending_list,cancel,transports. No get or revoke per spec. Following spec - spec is authoritative. pending_list is the list method. cancel replaces revoke semantically. If get is intended, please add to spec.
v1 limitation: direct transport URL hardcoded None. Spec example shows ws URL but this is documentation. Client discovers URL from network config.
v1 limitation: no scope check beyond principal. Spec mentions pairing:create for some methods but auth::check_server_policy only checks principal presence.
v1 limitation: redeem does NOT require principal per spec Server policy without specific scope. Other write methods DO require principal.
v1 limitation: no persistence, in-memory only. Restart loses all pairings.
v1 limitation: no notifications per spec line 872 此域无需要 resync 的 notification.
Brute-force: wrong secret increments attempts on recent pending pairing. After REDEEM_MAX_ATTEMPTS (5), pairing removed, returns not_found.
Self-redeem does not apply - no concept of self in pairing domain.
clientInfo validated non-empty after trim. No length bounds in v1.
clientToken format ct-{uuid} matches client-auth clientId. v1 does NOT auto-create ClientAuthRecord on redeem.
Transport validation: only direct or relay. Lowercase serialization via rename_all=lowercase.
create omits relay transport when not on relay connection (relayId unavailable).
transports returns BOTH direct and relay always, with available boolean.
Pagination: opaque cursor hex-encoded JSON via PaginatedResult::from_slice. limit 20 default, 100 max, 0 returns -32602.
Secret hash SHA-256 hex 64 chars. Plaintext never persisted.
All Mutex locks use .expect(pairing store mutex poisoned).
framework_notes: Integration: (1) ExtensionHandler trait via async_trait. Method dispatch match on sub_method string: create, redeem, pending_list, cancel, transports. Unknown methods return ExtensionError::method_not_found() (code -32601). (2) create, pending_list, cancel call auth::check_server_policy(ctx, pairing, method) returning -32002 when principal empty. redeem does NOT call auth (spec says Server policy without specific scope). (3) pending_list uses pagination::PaginationParams for cursor/limit. Cursor decoded via decode_cursor returning -32602 on invalid hex. limit clamped via limit_or_default(20, 100). limit=0 explicit -32602 check. (4) All 5 methods use ensure_object_params helper returning -32602 if params is not JSON object. (5) Pagination: sort by created_at ASC, then PaginatedResult::from_slice. (6) All Mutex locks use .expect(pairing store mutex poisoned). (7) Token formats: pairingId = pair- + uuid. secret = pair-secret- + uuid1.simple() + - + uuid2.simple(). clientToken = ct- + uuid. (8) Secret hash SHA-256 hex stored as secret_hash. Plaintext never persisted, only in create response. (9) is_expired helper: parse_from_rfc3339, fail=non-expired defensive. (10) is_relay_connection(ctx) = ctx.connection_id.starts_with(relay-). (11) chrono::Utc::now() captured once per create. (12) No notifications per spec line 872. (13) Brute-force: store.try_redeem increments attempts. After 5 failed, pairing removed, redeem returns not_found. (14) Self-redeem does not apply. (15) Pairing/client-auth integration OUT OF SCOPE for v1. (16) Transport type via rename_all=lowercase. type field via rename=type. url and relay_id skip_serializing_if Option::is_none.
